intro: North Korea is strong in weightlifting, wrestling, gymnastics and women's football.

chapters.title: Football
text: North Korea reached the quarter-finals of the 1966 World Cup, beating Italy. Its women's team has won youth World Cups.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Most of its Olympic medals have come in weightlifting, wrestling, boxing and gymnastics.
